                                                                        - Full Context Provenance (CTX-1)
                                                                        - macOS / arm64 Builds
                                                                        - Knowledge Freshness (CTX-2)
                                                                        - Composio 250+ App Mesh (WP-1306)
```

---

## 2. Milestone v1.1.0: Observability Foundations & Eval Harness

**Target:** Initial feature release post-v1.0.0
**Theme:** Establish the local trace standard, sanitize flight recordings, and migrate evaluation from ad-hoc scripts to versioned datasets with reference oracles.

### Work Packages

| ID | Title | Summary & Deliverables | Backlog / Audit Source |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **WP-1101** | **OpenTelemetry Local Tracing** | Implement `cli/src/core/trace.ts` providing hierarchical tracing conforming to OpenTelemetry GenAI semantics. Captures agent turn roots, model request spans, tool execution spans, and context compactions into local `trace.jsonl` files. | `LANGSMITH_REVIEW` §2.1 |
| **WP-1102** | **Flight Recorder Credential Redaction** | Implement automated zero-leak credential sanitization across all recorded spans, CLI error dumps, and debug journals, validating against the test fixtures in `docs/CRED003_FLIGHTRECORDER_SANITIZATION_EVIDENCE.md`. | `REQ-DX-105`, `CRED003` |
| **WP-1103** | **Versioned Evaluation Datasets** | Migrate `eval/tasks/` into structured datasets under `eval/datasets/`. Decouple task input specifications (`examples.jsonl`) from evaluation assertions (`oracles.jsonl`). Add versioning and dataset splits (`regression`, `benchmark`). | `LANGSMITH_REVIEW` §2.3 |
| **WP-1104** | **Standalone `nexus eval` Command** | Implement `nexus eval` subcommand in launcher grammar, supporting `--dataset <path>`, `--runs <count>`, `--isolated-home`, and structured JSON score outputs. | `REQ-EVL-101`, `ROADMAP.md` |
| **WP-1105** | **Deterministic Code Evaluators** | Implement modular evaluator library in `eval/evaluators/code/`: AST syntax validation, build pass/fail, typecheck exit codes, diff boundary compliance, and JSON repair rates. | `LANGSMITH_REVIEW` §4.1 |
| **WP-1106** | **Single Step Loop Mode** | Implement `--step` flag in `nexus run` and `/step` REPL command to execute one agent turn and pause deterministically for operator confirmation. | `REQ-AGT-111` |
| **WP-1107** | **Constrained Decoding & GBNF Tool Grammar Engine** | Implement dynamic Context-Free Grammar (GBNF) generation from registered tool schemas (`read_file`, `write_file`, `edit_file`, `run_command`). Interfaces with `llama.cpp` (`grammar`), `vLLM` (`guided_json`), and `Ollama` (`format`). Supports hybrid grammars (`<think>...</think>` + tool call) for reasoning models (DeepSeek R1). Targets near-zero JSON argument parse errors and enables reliable agentic execution on 7B/14B Q4_K_M local models. | `POSITIONING.md` §3.6, `SPEC-EVALUATION.md` §6 |
| **WP-1108** | **Zero Technical Debt & Dependency Modernization** | Triage, validate, and integrate the 27 post-v1.0.0 Dependabot PRs (#103–#129) under an absolute zero-deprecation policy for third-party libraries. Categorized across 5 staged batches: Core Rust runtime (#105, #107, #110, #113), GitHub Actions CI workflows (#103, #104, #106, #108, #112), Cloudflare micro-workers (#109, #115–#118, #121–#123, #125–#128), TypeScript compiler (#119, #124, #129), and CLI runtime migrations (#111, #114, #120 including Commander 12→15 compatibility audit). Enforces continuous zero-technical-debt invariants. | PRs #103–#129, `ROADMAP.md` §2.1 |

### v1.1.0 Release Gates

- **Gate G1.1-1 (Zero-Leak Tracing):** Local trace engine produces valid OTel GenAI spans for all turn steps without leaking environment credentials or writing outside `~/.local/share/nexus/traces/`.
- **Gate G1.1-2 (Dataset Decoupling):** Evaluator executes 100% of benchmark tasks with zero leakage of `oracles.jsonl` to agent prompt context.
- **Gate G1.1-3 (CLI Parity):** `nexus eval` executes cleanly from packaged binary installations without developer dependencies.
- **Gate G1.1-4 (Constrained Decoding Reliability):** GBNF-constrained execution achieves >=99.5% valid JSON tool call syntax (minimizing syntax repair retries) across supported local inference endpoints (llama.cpp, vLLM, Ollama).
- **Gate G1.1-5 (Zero Technical Debt & Zero Deprecated Packages):** Strictly 0 deprecated packages, 0 unmaintained dependencies, 0 CodeQL alerts, and 0 compiler warnings repository-wide. All 27 Dependabot PR upgrades pass unit/PTY suites, `cargo deny check`, automated npm registry deprecation scans, package reproducibility (`cmp`), and CLI option compatibility without breaking unprivileged sandbox invariants.

### 2.1 Dependabot Triage & Integration Matrix (WP-1108)

Following the PR #8 integration merge to `main`, Dependabot opened 27 automated dependency update pull requests (PRs #103–#129). These are triaged into 5 distinct integration batches scheduled for the v1.1.0 development cycle (deferred from v1.0.0):

#### Batch 1: Core Rust Engine Runtime (Low Risk / Initial v1.1.0 Release Cycle)
Patches to Rust core dependencies that preserve API compatibility and improve stability and performance:
- **PR #105:** `tokio` (1.53.1 → 1.53.3 in `/core`) — Async runtime maintenance patch.
- **PR #107:** `similar` (2.7.0 → 3.2.0 in `/core`) — Text diffing library major SemVer upgrade.
- **PR #110:** `libc` (0.2.189 → 0.2.191 in `/core`) — System call bindings patch.
- **PR #113:** `serde_json` (1.0.151 → 1.0.154 in `/core`) — Serialization optimization patch.
- *Verification Requirement:* `cargo test --locked --manifest-path core/Cargo.toml` under isolated HOME; bit-for-bit packaging `cmp` check.

#### Batch 2: Cloudflare Experimental Micro-Workers (Low Risk / Isolated)
Maintenance updates for the isolated Cloudflare artifacts vertical slice (retired contest contract track):
- **PRs #125, #126, #127, #128:** `vite` (8.3.3 → 8.3.4 across root and worker packages).
- **PRs #115, #117, #118:** `@cloudflare/vite-plugin` (2.0.0-beta.sha-52b0dc0e9 → 2.0.0-beta.v.1).
- **PRs #109, #116, #121, #122, #123:** `cf` (1.0.0-beta.10 → 1.0.0-beta.18 across worker bundles).
- *Verification Requirement:* `npm run build --prefix experiments/cloudflare-artifacts-vertical-slice` and typecheck pass.

#### Batch 3: GitHub Actions CI Workflows (Medium Risk / CI Pipeline Validation)
Modernization of hosted automation actions in `.github/workflows/`:
- **PR #103:** `actions/attest-build-provenance` (commit hash update for SLSA build provenance).
- **PR #104:** `actions/checkout` (v4.4.0 → v7.0.1) — Major runner checkout upgrade.
- **PR #106:** `actions/download-artifact` (v4.3.0 → v8.0.2) — Artifact fetcher upgrade.
- **PR #108:** `softprops/action-gh-release` (v2.6.2 → v3.0.3) — GitHub release asset upload upgrade.
- **PR #112:** `actions/setup-node` (v4.4.0 → v7.1.0) — Node environment provisioning upgrade.
- *Verification Requirement:* Staged workflow validation on test branch; assert identical artifact download and release asset publishing behavior.

Modernization of the TypeScript compiler toolchain:
- **PR #119:** `typescript` (5.9.3 → 7.0.2 in `/demo`) — Demo runner compiler bump.

- **PR #114:** `commander` (12.1.0 → 15.0.0 in `/cli`) — Major CLI option parser upgrade. Requires comprehensive audit of subcommands (`nexus run`, `check`, `models`, `upgrade`), option parsing (`--strict-token-count`, `--isolated-home`), and exit code propagation.
- **PR #120:** `ora` (8.2.0 → 9.4.1 in `/cli`) — Terminal spinner library update. Validate stdout/stderr streaming, non-interactive CI fallback, and Ratatui TUI coexistence.
- *Verification Requirement:* Full CLI unit and PTY suite (1,511+ tests), CLI journey tests (`cli/test/system_journey.test.ts`), and doctor verification.

---

## 3. Milestone v1.2.0: Experiment Comparison, Replay & Annotation

**Target:** Second feature release post-v1.0.0
**Theme:** Diagnostic reproducibility, statistical comparison across agent versions, interactive TUI trace inspection, and human annotation workflows.

| **WP-1202** | **Experiment Comparator** | Implement `eval/compare.mjs` comparing two experiment runs with Wilson score 95% confidence intervals, token cost deltas, duration deltas, and regression matrices. | `LANGSMITH_REVIEW` §2.4 |

# WP-1108 dependency modernization triage

This checkpoint records the dependency-policy batch selected from the post-v1.0
Dependabot set (#103–#129). It does not claim that every roadmap upgrade or the
G1.1-5 release gate is complete.

## Selected policy batch

- CI checks every committed, supported npm lockfile with
  `scripts/check_deprecated_lock.mjs`: CLI, demo, the Cloudflare experiment,
  its trusted broker bundle, and release tools. Held-out evaluation fixtures
  and private material are excluded.
- `deny.toml` sets `advisories.unmaintained = "all"` and
  `advisories.yanked = "deny"`. The existing CI cargo-deny advisory check
  rejects all crates covered by unmaintained advisories and rejects yanked
  crates instead of emitting a warning. The unmaintained setting is cargo-deny
  0.20.2's default, made explicit here as a maintained invariant ([advisory
  configuration reference](https://embarkstudios.github.io/cargo-deny/checks/advisories/cfg.html)).
- The deprecation checker’s messages now describe a generic lockfile; its
  fail-closed registry behavior is unchanged.

The current supported npm locks passed the deprecation scan at this checkpoint.
The current Rust dependency graph passed `cargo deny check advisories` with the
new yanked policy. No npm or Rust package versions were changed in the policy
batch; the separately reviewed #106 workflow-action update is recorded below.

CI now has a dedicated `cloudflare-experiment` job on Node 22 and 24. It runs
`npm ci`, then the top-level experiment package's existing `typecheck` and
`build` scripts, matching the roadmap's Cloudflare verification commands. It
also runs `agent-collab-fixture`'s existing `build` script; that fixture has no
lockfile of its own and uses the top-level install's TypeScript compiler. This
adds automated coverage only: no CI run has executed this job at this branch
head while SUITE is held, so a passing result is still required before these
updates are accepted.

The remaining nested package manifests are not covered transitively by the
top-level package: `agent-collab-worker`, `fork-worker`, and `shared-ref-worker`
have neither lockfiles nor build/typecheck scripts; `trusted-broker-bundle` has
its own lockfile but no build/typecheck script. The roadmap specifies verification
for the top-level experiment package only. No worker-specific build/install
command is added here because none is defined by those manifests, and inventing
one would not demonstrate compatibility of their declared, unlocked dependency
sets. These nested dependency entries therefore remain without experiment-level
build/typecheck evidence.

import { HARNESS_TOOLS } from "./capabilities.js";
import type { ToolDefinition } from "../types.js";

/** The v1.1.0 GBNF pilot is intentionally limited to these registered tools. */
export const GBNF_TOOL_ALLOWLIST = ["read_file", "write_file", "edit_file", "run_command"] as const;
export type GbnfToolName = (typeof GBNF_TOOL_ALLOWLIST)[number];

const ALLOWED_NAMES: ReadonlySet<string> = new Set(GBNF_TOOL_ALLOWLIST);
const MAX_PROPERTIES = 8;

/** Compile the exact parameter schema registered for one allowlisted tool. Unknown JSON Schema forms fail closed. */
export function generateToolArgumentsGbnf(
  toolName: GbnfToolName,
  registeredTools: readonly ToolDefinition[] = HARNESS_TOOLS,
): string {
  if (!ALLOWED_NAMES.has(toolName)) throw new Error(`GBNF is not enabled for tool ${String(toolName)}`);
  if (!Array.isArray(registeredTools)) throw new Error("registered tool definitions must be an array");

  const matches = registeredTools.filter((tool) => (tool as ToolDefinition | undefined)?.function?.name === toolName);
  if (matches.length !== 1) {
    throw new Error(`expected exactly one registered schema for ${toolName}; found ${matches.length}`);
  }
  const definition = matches[0] as ToolDefinition;
  if (definition.type !== "function" || !definition.function || definition.function.name !== toolName) {
    throw new Error(`registered schema for ${toolName} is not a function tool`);
  }
  const parameters = definition.function.parameters as unknown;
  if (!parameters || typeof parameters !== "object" || Array.isArray(parameters)) {
    throw new Error(`registered schema for ${toolName} must define an object parameter schema`);
  }

  const schema = parameters as Record<string, unknown>;
  rejectUnknownKeys(schema, new Set(["type", "properties", "required"]), `${toolName} parameter schema`);
  if (schema.type !== "object") throw new Error(`registered schema for ${toolName} must have type object`);
  if (!schema.properties || typeof schema.properties !== "object" || Array.isArray(schema.properties)) {
    throw new Error(`registered schema for ${toolName} must define flat properties`);
  }

  const propertyMap = schema.properties as Record<string, unknown>;
  const propertyNames = Object.keys(propertyMap);
  if (propertyNames.length > MAX_PROPERTIES) throw new Error(`${toolName} schema exceeds the ${MAX_PROPERTIES}-property GBNF bound`);
  const required = schema.required === undefined ? [] : schema.required;
  if (!Array.isArray(required) || required.some((name) => typeof name !== "string")) {
    throw new Error(`registered schema for ${toolName} has an invalid required list`);
  }
  if (new Set(required).size !== required.length) throw new Error(`registered schema for ${toolName} repeats a required property`);
  for (const name of required) {
    if (!Object.hasOwn(propertyMap, name)) throw new Error(`registered schema for ${toolName} requires undeclared property ${name}`);
  }

  const properties = propertyNames.map((name, index) => {
    const raw = propertyMap[name];
    if (!raw || typeof raw !== "object" || Array.isArray(raw)) {
      throw new Error(`registered property ${toolName}.${name} must be a flat schema object`);
    }
    const property = raw as Record<string, unknown>;
    rejectUnknownKeys(property, new Set(["type", "description"]), `${toolName}.${name} schema`);
    if (typeof property.description !== "undefined" && typeof property.description !== "string") {
      throw new Error(`registered property ${toolName}.${name} has an invalid description`);
    }
    const valueRule = property.type === "string" ? "json-string"
      : property.type === "number" ? "json-number"
        : property.type === "boolean" ? "json-boolean"
          : undefined;
    if (!valueRule) throw new Error(`unsupported JSON Schema type for ${toolName}.${name}`);
    return { name, index, valueRule };
  });

  const propertyIndex = new Map(properties.map(({ name, index }) => [name, index]));
  const requiredMask = required.reduce((mask: number, name: string) => mask | (1 << propertyIndex.get(name)!), 0);
  const stateCount = 1 << properties.length;
  const rules = [
    "root ::= ws \"{\" ws object-fields ws \"}\" ws",
    "json-string ::= \"\\\"\" json-char* \"\\\"\"",
    String.raw`json-char ::= [^"\\\x00-\x1f] | "\\" (["\\/bfnrt] | "u" [0-9a-fA-F]{4})`,
    String.raw`json-number ::= "-"? ("0" | [1-9] [0-9]*) ("." [0-9]+)? ([eE] [-+]? [0-9]+)?`,
    "json-boolean ::= \"true\" | \"false\"",
    "ws ::= [ \\t\\n\\r]*",
    ...properties.map(({ name, index, valueRule }) => `member_${index} ::= ${JSON.stringify(name)} ws ":" ws ${valueRule}`),
  ];

  const firstChoices = properties.map(({ index }) => `member_${index} fields_tail_${1 << index}`);
  rules.push(`object-fields ::= ${requiredMask === 0 ? '"" | ' : ""}${firstChoices.length ? firstChoices.join(" | ") : '""'}`);
  for (let mask = 0; mask < stateCount; mask++) {
    const choices: string[] = [];
    if ((mask & requiredMask) === requiredMask) choices.push('""');
    for (const { index } of properties) {
      const bit = 1 << index;
      if ((mask & bit) === 0) choices.push(`"," ws member_${index} fields_tail_${mask | bit}`);
    }
    // Only reachable states need a rule, but emitting all bounded masks keeps output deterministic and simple.
    rules.push(`fields_tail_${mask} ::= ${choices.join(" | ") || '""'}`);
  }
  return rules.join("\n");
}

/** Compile each registered schema from the allowlist; unrelated registered tools are intentionally ignored. */
export function generateRegisteredToolArgumentGrammars(
  registeredTools: readonly ToolDefinition[] = HARNESS_TOOLS,
): Readonly<Record<GbnfToolName, string>> {
  const result = {} as Record<GbnfToolName, string>;
  for (const toolName of GBNF_TOOL_ALLOWLIST) result[toolName] = generateToolArgumentsGbnf(toolName, registeredTools);
  return result;
}

function rejectUnknownKeys(value: Record<string, unknown>, allowed: ReadonlySet<string>, label: string): void {
  const unknown = Object.keys(value).find((key) => !allowed.has(key));
  if (unknown) throw new Error(`${label} contains unsupported schema keyword ${unknown}`);
}

import { HARNESS_TOOLS } from "./capabilities.js";
import type { ToolDefinition } from "../types.js";

/** The v1.1.0 GBNF pilot is intentionally limited to these registered tools. */
export const GBNF_TOOL_ALLOWLIST = ["read_file", "write_file", "edit_file", "run_command"] as const;
export type GbnfToolName = (typeof GBNF_TOOL_ALLOWLIST)[number];

const ALLOWED_NAMES: ReadonlySet<string> = new Set(GBNF_TOOL_ALLOWLIST);
const MAX_PROPERTIES = 8;

/** Compile the exact parameter schema registered for one allowlisted tool. Unknown JSON Schema forms fail closed. */
export function generateToolArgumentsGbnf(
  toolName: GbnfToolName,
  registeredTools: readonly ToolDefinition[] = HARNESS_TOOLS,
): string {
  if (!ALLOWED_NAMES.has(toolName)) throw new Error(`GBNF is not enabled for tool ${String(toolName)}`);
  if (!Array.isArray(registeredTools)) throw new Error("registered tool definitions must be an array");

  const matches = registeredTools.filter((tool) => (tool as ToolDefinition | undefined)?.function?.name === toolName);
  if (matches.length !== 1) {
    throw new Error(`expected exactly one registered schema for ${toolName}; found ${matches.length}`);
  }
  const definition = matches[0] as ToolDefinition;
  if (definition.type !== "function" || !definition.function || definition.function.name !== toolName) {
    throw new Error(`registered schema for ${toolName} is not a function tool`);
  }
  const parameters = definition.function.parameters as unknown;
  if (!parameters || typeof parameters !== "object" || Array.isArray(parameters)) {
    throw new Error(`registered schema for ${toolName} must define an object parameter schema`);
  }

  const schema = parameters as Record<string, unknown>;
  rejectUnknownKeys(schema, new Set(["type", "properties", "required"]), `${toolName} parameter schema`);
  if (schema.type !== "object") throw new Error(`registered schema for ${toolName} must have type object`);
  if (!schema.properties || typeof schema.properties !== "object" || Array.isArray(schema.properties)) {
    throw new Error(`registered schema for ${toolName} must define flat properties`);
  }

  const propertyMap = schema.properties as Record<string, unknown>;
  const propertyNames = Object.keys(propertyMap);
  if (propertyNames.length > MAX_PROPERTIES) throw new Error(`${toolName} schema exceeds the ${MAX_PROPERTIES}-property GBNF bound`);
  const required = schema.required === undefined ? [] : schema.required;
  if (!Array.isArray(required) || required.some((name) => typeof name !== "string")) {
    throw new Error(`registered schema for ${toolName} has an invalid required list`);
  }
  if (new Set(required).size !== required.length) throw new Error(`registered schema for ${toolName} repeats a required property`);
  for (const name of required) {
    if (!Object.hasOwn(propertyMap, name)) throw new Error(`registered schema for ${toolName} requires undeclared property ${name}`);
  }

  const properties = propertyNames.map((name, index) => {
    const raw = propertyMap[name];
    if (!raw || typeof raw !== "object" || Array.isArray(raw)) {
      throw new Error(`registered property ${toolName}.${name} must be a flat schema object`);
